title: Cape Cod Old Kings Highway Self Guided Scenic Audio Driving Tour
blurb:
Explore the charm of Cape Cod on the Old Kings Highway, a scenic drive along Massachusetts Route 6A. This self-guided tour reveals centuries-old villages, picturesque landscapes, and historic landmarks from Sandwich to Provincetown. Discover the stories of early settlers and maritime legends as you meander through colonial homes, cranberry bogs, and art-filled towns. Perfect for history enthusiasts and leisurely travelers alike, this tour offers a unique perspective on Cape Cod’s heritage. Plan for a full day to soak in the sights, whether you’re drawn by summer sun or fall foliage.

- Scenic self-guided drive through Cape Cod’s historic Route 6A
- Visit charming towns including Sandwich, Barnstable, and Provincetown
- Discover colonial homes, art galleries, and cranberry bogs along the way
- Ideal for all travelers seeking history and beautiful landscapes
